allow: Bash(node -e "const j = require\('./messages/en.json'\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\({nav: j.nav}, null, 2\)\)")

PowerShell(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 20; foreach \($f in @\("ar","en","tr"\)\) { $p = "messages/$f.json"; try { Get-Content $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null; "$f.json OK" } catch { "$f.json INVALID: $_" } })
